description: This file defines a utility for loading and parsing an ONNX graph from a file, converting it into Protocol Buffer message objects used within TensorBoard. It contains functions to load an ONNX model, parse the graph to extract nodes and attributes, and convert data into protobuf message formats.

classes.name: NodeDef
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing a node definition in the graph.

classes.name: GraphDef
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing the entire graph.

classes.name: VersionDef
classes.description: Protobuf message class containing version information.

classes.name: AttrValue
classes.description: Protobuf message class encapsulating attribute values.

classes.name: TensorShapeProto
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing tensor shape information.

methods.name: load_onnx_graph(fname)
methods.description: Loads an ONNX model from a file and parses its graph into protobuf format.

methods.name: parse(graph)
methods.description: Converts an ONNX graph object into TensorFlow protobuf graph definition with nodes and attributes.
